status: FROZEN before any base-resolved arm was fitted
title: Base-resolved observation head on the frozen Wave F v2 four-lineage cohort

cohort.content: 4 non-viral lineages, 5 profiles, 382 scored nucleotides (adenine SHAPE 71, P4-P6 SHAPE 158, P4-P6 DMS 78, TPP DMS 36, ydaO DMS 39)

protocol_reused_unchanged: forward_head_pilot.py v2 (sha256 1adceaa9...) imported read-only: same features for the sequence and secondary arms, same scored rows (observed & C4'-valid & secondary-valid), same chemistry-specific slope blocks, same precision weights (error floor 0.1; unweighted refit), same outer leave-one-lineage-out and inner leave-one-training-lineage-out alpha selection over [1e-4..10], same equal-lineage metrics, same paired lineage percentile bootstrap (10,000, seed 20261014) and the same study-holdout sensitivity.

arms.base_context: sequence + secondary + base-resolved block (C4' block replaced)
arms.shuffled_base_context: base-resolved block rows permuted within profile among chemically eligible scored positions using exactly the Wave F v2 permutation (seed 20261014 + first 32 bits of SHA-256(example_id))

base_resolved_descriptors.definition:
Analysis B, step 1 (structure only; reads no reactivity values).

Base-resolved descriptors for every core nucleotide of the frozen Wave F v2 cohort, computed
from the all-atom deposited crystal chain (whole chain, not only the probed core) plus the
assay ligand where the probed profile is ligand-present. Per nucleotide (fixed physical scales):

  dms_atom_sasa  SASA of the DMS-reactive atom (A N1, C N3; 0 for G/U)          / 10 A^2
  o2p_sasa       SASA of the 2'-O (O2')                                         / 10 A^2
  base_sasa      SASA of all base heavy atoms (base-face exposure)              / 100 A^2
  canonical_pair cis Watson-Crick or G.U pair to any residue of the chain (0/1)
  base_hbond     number of residues with a base-base N/O...N/O <= 3.4 A, capped at 2, / 2
  stack_5p       base stacked on the 5' chain neighbour (0/1)
  stack_3p       base stacked on the 3' chain neighbour (0/1)
  stack_nonlocal base stacked on any non-neighbour residue (0/1)

Geometric criteria are those of structure_features.py (frozen; identical to Analysis A).
Writes results/analysisB_descriptors.json.
base_resolved_descriptors.structure_context: whole deposited RNA chain (not only the probed core) plus assay ligand heavy atoms; no waters, ions, other chains or symmetry mates

comparisons: Wave F v2 four comparisons plus secondary->base, shuffled_base->base, sequence->base, geometry(C4')->base; reference minus candidate MSE per held-out lineage (positive favours base), for error_weighted (error-weighted and unweighted MSE) and the unweighted refit
interval: Descriptive paired percentile 95% bootstrap over the 4 lineages (identical to Wave F v2); no p-values
interpretation_gate: Base-resolved geometry is described as adding held-out information only if, in BOTH the error-weighted primary and the unweighted refit, the mean lineage difference favours base_context over secondary_context AND over shuffled_base_context, with at least 3 of 4 held-out lineages favouring base_context in each of those four comparisons. Otherwise the result is reported as null or mixed. Base-versus-sequence and base-versus-C4' are descriptive.

shuffle_calibration.rationale: In the pre-freeze plumbing test on seeded random targets the inherited Wave F gate was met by chance (base and C4' arms both beat secondary on 4/4 lineages by ~1% MSE), so the single seeded shuffle is not a calibrated control. A pre-registered calibration therefore refits 500 independent within-profile shuffles of the base block (and, for reference, of the C4' block) with the full nested procedure; one-sided permutation p = (1 + #{shuffled equal-lineage MSE <= observed}) / 501, per weighting scheme.
shuffle_calibration.role: Base-resolved geometry is described as carrying information beyond its shuffled marginals only if the frozen gate is met AND the calibration p < 0.05 in both schemes. The gate alone is reported but is not sufficient.

reproduction_requirement: The run must reproduce the published Wave F v2 lineage metrics and selected alphas for the four original arms (|difference| < 1e-10) or it stops without reporting the base arm.
disclosures: Descriptor thresholds are shared with Analysis A and were fixed on crystal structures only.
Wave F v2 results for the original four arms were known before this plan (they are the published null). No base-resolved arm had been fitted.

A plumbing test on seeded random targets was run before freezing (results/synthetic_test_analysisB.json); it contains no real data. On those random targets the inherited Wave F gate was met (base and C4' arms both beat secondary and their single shuffle), while the 500-shuffle calibration gave p = 0.08-0.14; this motivated making the calibration a required part of the interpretation.
